reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many downstream services including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these downstream services have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow internally but requests queue before reaching CPU in frontend.
CPU usage of frontend is at 74% of its very low CPU limit (0.007 cores used of 0.010 cores limit), confirming CPU throttling and resource exhaustion in frontend.
No errors are reported on these edges except a small 2.9% on frontend->adservice, which is a symptom, not a root cause.
Pod of frontend was recreated 331 seconds ago due to a recent configuration change reducing CPU limit drastically from 200m to 10m, explaining the resource exhaustion.
Therefore, frontend is the root cause due to resource exhaustion caused by CPU limit reduction, propagating latency to all downstream services on the critical path and others.
